app.title: PDF Toolkit
app.tagline: Simple, private PDF tools - processed entirely in your browser

session.confirmDescription: Download a copy first if you want to keep your changes.
session.downloadHint: Download a copy. Keeps the unsaved-changes state.
session.saveHint: Download and mark the document as saved.

common.dragDropHere: Drag & drop a PDF file here, or click to browse
common.dragDropMultiple: Drag & drop PDF files here, or click to browse
common.highResolutionPreview: Preview skipped to limit decoding memory. Full image resolution is preserved; editing and download are still available.

merge.title: Merge PDFs
merge.description: Combine multiple PDF files into one. Drag to reorder before merging.
merge.minimumFiles: Add at least 2 PDF files to merge.
merge.keyboardInstructions: Press Space to pick up a file, arrow keys to move it, Space to drop, or Escape to cancel.

compress.title: Compress PDF
compress.description: Reduce file size by optimising the internal PDF structure.
compress.note: Uses structural compression (object streams). Image quality is not changed.
compress.noReduction: The rewrite did not reduce size. The original file was kept in the session.

extract.title: Extract Pages
extract.description: Extract specific pages or page ranges into a new PDF.
extract.hint: Enter page numbers and ranges, e.g. 1,3,5-8
extract.previewHint: Select pages. Thumbnails load as you scroll.

rotate.title: Rotate Pages
rotate.description: Rotate pages in your PDF by 90, 180, or 270 degrees.

resize.title: Resize Pages
resize.description: Resize all pages in your PDF to a standard paper size.

crop.title: Crop Pages
crop.description: Set the visible area of PDF pages using margin values.
crop.note: Visual crop only - content outside the crop box is hidden, not removed from the file.

versionFix.title: Version Fix
versionFix.description: Detect and rewrite the PDF version header to a target version.
versionFix.note: Edits only the three version characters in the header. Features stay unchanged; this is not compatibility conversion.
versionFix.details: Older-reader support and PDF/A are not guaranteed. Unsupported features remain, a catalog version can override the header, and editing can invalidate digital signatures.
versionFix.lowerWarning: An older header does not make newer PDF features compatible with older readers.
versionFix.catalogWarning: The document catalog still declares PDF {{version}} and may override this header. Older-reader compatibility is not guaranteed.

images.title: Images to PDF
images.description: Combine images into a PDF, one image per page. Reorder before creating your working document.
images.upload: Drag & drop images here, or click to browse
images.formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF and BMP · multiple files supported
images.frameNote: GIF and animated WebP use the first frame only. TIFF is not supported.
images.sizingNote: Original size uses source DPI when available, otherwise 96 DPI. Margins add to the original page. Small margins: 12 pt; normal: 24 pt. Pixel resolution is preserved; Fill crops visually.
images.success: PDF ready. Use the working-file toolbar to download or continue editing.
images.replaceDescription: Your current working PDF will be replaced. Download it first if you want to keep it. Images remain selected if conversion fails.

errors.type: Choose a supported image: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or BMP. The file must contain image data.
errors.tiff: TIFF is not supported. Export its first page as PNG or JPEG first; additional pages are not imported.
errors.corrupt: This image could not be decoded. It may be damaged or use an unsupported encoding.
errors.batch: Use at most 100 images per queue. Split larger collections into batches.
errors.processing: Could not create the PDF. Try fewer or smaller images, or another supported format.
errors.output: The generated PDF exceeds the 100 MiB working-document limit. Use fewer or smaller images.
errors.sessionChanged: The working PDF changed during conversion. It has been kept; create the image PDF again when ready.
errors.resource: This encoding needs more decoding memory than the browser budget allows. Try a non-interlaced RGB/RGBA PNG or JPEG, a smaller batch, or a device with more memory.
errors.encoding: This PNG encoding is not supported by the streaming path in this browser. Export a non-interlaced RGB/RGBA PNG or JPEG, or try a current browser. No automatic downscaling was applied.
errors.pageSize: Original Size exceeds the compatible PDF page bound used here (200 inches / 14,400 default points). Choose A4 or Letter, or correct the source DPI. Embedded image pixels are not reduced.

errors.invalid: This PDF is malformed, empty or unsupported. Try exporting it again from its original application.
errors.encrypted: Encrypted PDFs are not supported. Decrypt a copy locally before using this tool.
errors.tooLarge: The limit is 100 MiB per PDF or combined merge input. Split the document locally first.
errors.version: A complete, supported PDF header must appear at the start of the file.
errors.processing: The operation failed. Check your page range, margins and PDF, then try again.
errors.fileType: Choose PDF files. Other file types are not supported.

workspace.local: Private document workspace · processed in your browser

preview.title: Document preview
preview.imageLimited: A lightweight thumbnail is shown to protect decoding memory. Original image quality is unchanged.
preview.bounded: Preview resolution is bounded; export resolution is unchanged.

document.replaceDescription: The current document has unsaved changes. Replace it? You can undo this replacement.
document.empty: Open a PDF or create one with a tool. Your document stays available across tools.
document.infoText: Revision {{revision}}. All processing and history stay in memory in this browser. Page removal is not secure redaction.
document.deleteDescription: Remove {{count}} pages from the working document? You can undo this action.
document.clearDescription: Discard the working document and all Undo/Redo history? This cannot be undone.
document.historyLimit: Older checkpoints were discarded. History keeps at most 20 steps and 128 MiB of previous PDF data.
document.dragStart: Page picked up. Use arrow keys to move, Space to drop, Escape to cancel.

errors.stale: The document changed before this operation finished. Please try again.
errors.selection: The page selection is no longer valid. Select pages again.
errors.empty: A document must contain at least one page.
errors.busy: Wait for the current operation to finish.
errors.resource: The operation could not finish. The previous document is unchanged. Try fewer pages or close other browser tabs.

document.selectInPanel: Select pages in the document panel, or enter a page range below.
